title: Readmission — return from an approved leave
story: Therese Lacson is a Master of Arts in Education student on an approved Leave of Absence (AY 2026-2027 1st Semester, running until Nov 29, 2026). Her enrollment is closed until a readmission is approved, so she files a separate Readmission request in the Student Portal: the semester she wants to return in, why she is ready, and four confirmations.

The request travels on the same staged board as the Leave of Absence. Staff drag the card to In staff review, read the policy check, verify the checklist and forward the case. The Dean drags the card to approve; on approval the student is active again and the Academic Coordinator plans the enrollment as a separate step.
accounts: Therese Lacson, on leave, files the readmission
Readmission board, drag to In staff review, verifies the checklist, forwards to the Dean
data: My leave is ending and I am ready to resume thesis work with my adviser. My study plan is updated and I have no pending accountability.
all four items ticked: Structured return intention completed, Updated study plan confirmed, Program or adviser consultation completed, No pending accountability confirmed
Return semester is after the leave; checklist is complete. Forwarded for the Dean's decision.
Approved. The Academic Coordinator will plan the enrollment for the return semester.

parts.title: Part A - The student asks to come back
parts.intro: Therese's demo account is reset first so the case starts from the same state every time.

steps.text: Sign in as Therese Lacson and open **Readmission** under Requests. The page reads "Not submitted". A blue notice says "You are on leave of absence. Your enrollment is closed until a readmission is approved." and names the leave she is ending (AY 2026-2027 1st Semester, running until Nov 29, 2026). Readmission is therefore a separate request, not an extension of the leave form.

shots.caption: Readmission page of a student on leave.

steps.text: Open **Rules applied on this screen**. It lists one rule from the Graduate School policies: a returning student writes an intent to enroll, addressed to the University Registrar through the Graduate School Dean (Handbook 2022-2023, p. 53), enforced by the system.

shots.caption: The one handbook rule behind the screen, with its source page.

steps.text: Choose **Semester you want to return in** (AY 2026-2027 2nd Semester; the list starts after the current semester, and the page notes that a student may ask to return before the leave ends but the Dean decides whether that is allowed). Type the reason in **Why you are ready to come back** and tick the four items under "Before you send this, confirm each item".

shots.caption: Request filled in with the four confirmations ticked.

steps.text: Click **Submit readmission request**. The page shows "Submitted. Graduate School staff will review your readmission request.", status **Submitted**, **Waiting for: Graduate School Staff**, the ticked checklist, and a four-step tracker (Request submitted, Staff review, Dean decision, Back in the program). **Withdraw request** remains available.

shots.caption: After submitting: waiting for Graduate School Staff.

parts.title: Part B - Staff review on the Readmission board

steps.text: Sign in as GS Staff, open **Readmission** under Standalone Processes and search Therese. The board columns are Submitted, In staff review, Returned to student, With the Dean, Approved - back in the program and Not approved. Therese's card is in Submitted: "Returning: AY 2026-2027 2nd Semester", **Next: Graduate School Staff**, tag **Awaiting your review**.

shots.caption: Readmission board filtered to Therese: the card is in Submitted.

steps.text: Drag the card onto **In staff review**. "Therese Lacson: Review started." appears and the card sits in the new column. This is a real drag and drop; the **Move to...** button on the card does the same for keyboard and phone users.

shots.caption: After the drop: the card is in In staff review.

steps.text: Click **View details**. The window shows the tracker (Staff review is the current step) and the request: return semester, the student's intention, the linked leave (Leave of Absence, AY 2026-2027 1st Semester, On leave) and the eligibility result (Not set yet). Scroll to the **Policy check** ("Advice for staff - the Dean decides"). The result reads **Eligible to Return**, suggested for the Dean: Approve, and lists the checks (readmission application present, previous LOA period present, target return semester present, and so on).

shots.caption: Request window: request, linked leave, eligibility not set yet.
Policy check inside the request window.

steps.text: Click **Forward to Dean**. The window offers an **Eligibility result** (default: use the policy check result, Eligible to Return) and a **Return checklist**: each item is marked "The student ticked this" and staff tick it to mark it verified. The window warns that anything left unticked reaches the Dean as Needs Review. Tick all four items, type the note for the Dean and click **Forward to Dean**.

shots.caption: Forward to Dean: staff verify the four checklist items.

steps.text: "Therese Lacson: Forwarded to the Dean." appears. Close the window: the card is in **With the Dean**, **Next: Dean**.

shots.caption: The card is with the Dean.

parts.title: Part C - The Dean decides on the same board

steps.text: Sign in as the Dean and open **Readmission** in the sidebar. The Dean sees the same staged board; Therese's card is in **With the Dean**.

shots.caption: Dean's Readmission board with the card in With the Dean.

steps.text: Drag the card onto **Approved - back in the program**. The window **Approve** opens (Therese Lacson - Readmission, With the Dean to Approved) with an optional note and the buttons **Cancel** and **Approve**. Type the comment and click **Approve**. The card moves to Approved - back in the program.

shots.caption: Approve window opened by the drop.

parts.title: Part D - What the screens show afterwards

steps.text: Back on the staff Readmission board the card is in **Approved - back in the program** ("The student is active again. The Academic Coordinator plans the enrollment.") with **Next: Academic Coordinator** and **Registrar: Pending Handoff**; the Registrar list now offers the download buttons.

shots.caption: Staff board: approved, back in the program.
Request window of the approved case: all four tracker steps done, eligibility result Eligible to Return.

steps.text: Sign in as Therese again and open Readmission. The status is **Approved** and the discussion shows the Dean's message: the readmission is approved, she is active for AY 2026-2027 2nd Semester, the Academic Coordinator will plan her subjects, and enrollment is a separate step. The Dean's comment is the newest post, highlighted in green.

shots.caption: Student's view after the Dean's decision.

notes: Readmission restores the student to active standing; it does not enroll her in subjects. The Academic Coordinator plans the enrollment afterwards.
The policy check is advice for staff; the Dean decides. Items staff leave unticked reach the Dean as Needs Review.
As with Leave of Absence, the approved request goes to the Registrar list, which staff download and email themselves; the portal sends no email.
